verdict.rationale: Shopify offers broad Admin GraphQL/REST and Storefront APIs covering apps, checkout, catalog, orders, webhooks, and even emerging agentic/UCP endpoints, suggesting wide API-UI parity (shopify-docs-31, shopify-docs-19, shopify-probe-rt-3/4). However, independent developer reports cite concrete parity gaps — e.g. 'there's no way to do refunds via the API' and certain account tiers being locked out of parts of the API, forcing CSV workarounds instead of full UI-equivalent API access (shopify-comm-9, shopify-comm-12). Missing for 10: documented API coverage matching 100% of admin UI actions (e.g. refunds, full account management) and resolution of the cited account-tier API restrictions.
